newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish FinMin to present budget 1100 GMT Tues.
newsitem.headline: Swedish FinMin to present budget 1100 GMT Tues.

text.p: Sweden's Finance Minister Erik Asbrink will present the government spring budget proposal to parliament at 1100 GMT on Tuesday, April 15, the Finance Department said on Monday.
After the presentation, that will last about 10 minutes, there will be a parliamentary debate until 1400 GMT, the department said in a statement.

The department said Bo Lundgren from the Moderates, Per-Ola Eriksson from the Centre Party, the Liberal's Lars Leijonborg, Left Party's Johan Lonnrot, Roy Ottosson from the Greens, and Mats Odell of the Christian Democrats would join Asbrink in the debate.
Reuters Financial Television (RFTV) will broadcast Asbrink's presentation at 11o0 GMT followed by commentary from some analysts.
Asbrink will hold a press conference at around 1415 GMT.
